failures: WebSearch returns only AI-written summaries: no page could be opened, so every web-only record carries bibliographic_verified=false and its excerpt is a sentence quoted inside a summary (itself quoting the abstract page), not a direct quotation of the original paper.

Springer DOI-only queries (10.1007/BF02239129, BF00319717, BF00339749, BF00338326, BF00341994, BF00343880, BF01227769) returned no identifiable page; those items were not recorded. DOI 10.1007/BF00225570 (trout paraphysis) was recorded with title/authors/year/journal empty because none was displayed; PubMed convert_article_ids returns no PMID for it and PubMed title/abstract searches do not find it.

Brain and Nerve (Igaku-Shoin, webview.isho.jp) pages show only abstract/introduction; for DOI 10.11477/mf.1406203377 the title and authors were not displayed (year 1973 and the English abstract were), and for Sakata et al (Brain and Nerve 22(11) 1325-1332) the year was not displayed. PubMed lookup_article_by_citation returned NOT_FOUND for Baba et al 1976 (pp 873-881) so it stays unverified.

No PubMed record with paraphysis/paraphyse/parafisis in title or abstract exists for Russian, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese or Italian; the only non-English paraphysis-titled PubMed items are German, French and Dutch and were already held by other agents. Russian (Ontogenez 2025) and Portuguese (UFRGS dissertation 1999) items are web-only.

Spanish-language clinical colloid-cyst papers (Gaceta Medica de Mexico 2004 PMID 15559240, Medicina Sur 2001, Anales de Radiologia Mexico 2013, Revista de Neurologia 2002 PMID 12717670, Dialnet items) surfaced but no 'paráfisis' text could be confirmed; only the 2021 Cordoba paper (explicit statement on endodermal origin) was recorded as peripheral.

Okajimas Folia Anatomica Japonica (Gupta & Shrivastava, vol 49 issues 2-3): authors' initials, year and page range were not displayed in the summary (J-STAGE URL token '49_111' suggests a first page of 111 but this is not stated); recorded with year 0 and empty pages.

Eycleshymer 1892 ('Ueber die Paraphyse und Epiphyse') and Kappers 1982 (chapter on paraphysis cerebri) were only mentioned in passing without journal/volume details, so they were not recorded as separate records.

PubMed MCP returned RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED once on get_article_metadata (PMID 13359714); the retry worked. No Scite or Elicit tool was called; Wiley Scholar Gateway was not used in this channel. No direct HTTP to blocked hosts was attempted.
